style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight

second_characters: ONE crab buyer, his opponent, fighting him for the roe every beat, claw huge at the lens; ONE shrimp crossing the lens

motion_rule: the frame is TALL and narrow and the hero fills half its height in EVERY beat, his head a third of it, never small or far. He works OUT IN FRONT of the stall and throws his whole body the full frame width every beat, mouth to the lens, the crab pulling the other way, the shrimp crossing the glass. The world flies INTO the lens. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, the line is said once and ends by 5.75, then glass carries it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable, nothing in it
